title: Earn Wednesday: New Limited-Time Offers Available Now! (2025-01-29)
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians,  Binance Earn presents to you new offers that will launch each Wednesday. Stay tuned for Earn Wednesday to get rewards across Simple Earn, ETH Staking, SOL Staking, Dual Investment and more. 	 Trending Limited-Time Offers Product Offerings Duration APR Min. Offers are available on a  first-come, first-served  basis.  Once subscribed, users can view their assets by going to Assets > Earn. Users may choose to redeem their assets in advance in Simple Earn Locked Products. After choosing early redemption, the principal will be returned to the Spot Account, and the distributed interest will be deducted from the refunded principal. Due to differing global time zones,  it may take up to 72 hours to receive the tokens . However, in the case of exceptional circumstances the return of such assets may be delayed further. Please see our  terms  and  risk warning  for more details. Users will automatically receive rewards from ongoing Launchpools when they hold  BNB Flexible Products and/or BNB Locked Products positions . Refer to this  announcement  for more information. Users may also accrue scores and qualify for  Megadrop rewards  with active BNB Locked Products positions. For more details, please refer to the  FAQ .  On top of that, users who subscribe to BNB Simple Earn products (Flexible  and/or  Locked) with their BNB holdings can receive airdropped tokens via  HODLer Airdrops .  ********** More Earn Updates & Promotions  	 Binance Earn Lunar New Year Festival: Get Up to 20% APR and a Share of $150,000 Red Packet Pool From  2025-01-22 00:00 (UTC) to 2025-02-10 23:59 (UTC) , all eligible users who subscribed to ACH, BB, COS, NEIRO, POND, or SLF Flexible Products can enjoy  20% Bonus Tiered APR  rewards on top of Real-Time APR rewards . In addition, users who  opt-in to the Promotion  and subscribe with a net eligible subscription amount of  at least $10  to USDT, USDC, ACH, BB, COS, NEIRO, POND or SLF Flexible Products will be eligible to receive  a Red Packet from the $150,000 reward pool.  For more information, refer to this  announcement . Introducing MANTRA (OM) and Renzo (REZ) on BNSOL Super Stake: HODL BNSOL to Get OM and REZ APR Boost Airdrop Rewards Users who hold BNSOL or stake SOL into BNSOL in their Binance account or Binance Wallet  from 2025-01-01 00:00 (UTC) to 2025-01-31 23:59 (UTC)  will receive OM APR Boost Airdrop Rewards. For more information, refer to this  announcement . Users who hold BNSOL or stake SOL into BNSOL in their Binance account or Binance Wallet from  2025-01-13 00:00 (UTC) to 2025-01-31 23:59 (UTC)  will receive REZ APR Boost Airdrop Rewards respectively. For more information, refer to this  announcement . Binance Earn Carnival: Subscribe to Smart Arbitrage and Share 25,000 USDC in Rewards From  2025-01-17 05:00 (UTC) to 2025-02-06 23:59 (UTC) , all  new Smart Arbitrage users  who  opt-in to the Promotion  and subscribe to Smart Arbitrage with  at least 100   USDT  for  more than 72 hours  will have a chance to win  500 USDC. From  2025-01-17 05:00 (UTC) to 2025-02-06 23:59 (UTC) , users who  opt-in to the Promotion  and subscribe to Smart Arbitrage with  at least 500 USDT  will be eligible to earn up to  2,000 USDC .  For more information, refer to this  announcement .
